title: Provider Adapter & Capability-Negotiation Framework
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-26 America/Chicago after fresh verification of AIOC main ba935731e3db086ae27d99cb08135eddd580f7c0 and application main c7e763f4e9a7cf64c3936a4d67203a1cd6c6ef22, re-reading the AAI program/backlog, AAI-03 selection checkpoint, completed AAI-02 checkpoint and the AAI-01 provider/API/license registry in the application repository, then resolving the bounded provider-neutral adapter/capability-negotiation/persistence/validation contract before implementation branch creation.
objective: Define and prove a provider-neutral adapter descriptor and capability-negotiation framework that consumes AAI-01 governed capability evidence and AAI-02 canonical provider/source/reference contracts without making provider calls. The framework advertises only evidence-backed capability, fails closed for unsupported or unverified states, produces deterministic negotiation receipts and explicit manual/external/unavailable outcomes, and preserves all existing gameplay-owner and rights boundaries. This tranche does not implement provider-specific live adapters, authentication, catalogs, playback, semantic resolution, acquisition or payments.

adapter.rule: An adapter descriptor is static capability evidence, not a live provider session. Provider-native identity remains separate from canonical AAI-02 source/reference identity and semantic AudioIntent.

capabilities.rule: Capability advertisement reuses AAI-01 evidence states verbatim. Only supported-documented and supported-user-controlled are usable evidence states; every other state remains fail closed and no state may be upgraded by inference.

negotiation.mapping_rule: supported-documented maps to available-documented. supported-user-controlled maps to available-user-controlled except external-reference/user-controlled-app descriptors may report manual-external-reference because AAI-03 does not automate provider applications. provider-contact-required, planned-not-current, unsupported-by-terms, not-publicly-documented, unknown-unverified and not-applicable map to explicit non-usable outcomes.
negotiation.selection_rule: If candidateAdapterIds are authored, evaluate them in authored order and choose the first usable outcome. Otherwise evaluate registered adapters in stable adapterId order. Never select an adapter whose providerId conflicts with an explicit request providerId. Never fall back from a denied/unknown provider capability to scraping, reverse engineering or content copying.
negotiation.receipt_rule: Negotiation receipts include request ID, capability, evaluated adapter IDs/states/outcomes, selected adapter or null, selected outcome, source/provider filters and fixed authority flags. Platform paths, timing, credentials, live provider responses and network state are excluded.

identity.rule: Adapter/session/authentication/entitlement capability, AAI-02 AudioProvider/AudioSource/ProviderReference identity and semantic AudioIntent remain separate. Negotiation cannot create or rewrite provider, source, asset, cue, soundscape or gameplay identity.

rights.rule: AAI-03 capability evidence never overrides AAI-02 rights matrices. A technically advertised operation still requires separately granted AAI-02 rights evidence before later execution authority could use it.

owner_boundaries.rule: AAI-03 may carry non-mutating owner references only. Negotiation results are integration-support state and cannot create, replace or mutate World/Event/Scene/Combat/Action/Visibility/D29 truth.

persistence.result: No durable runtime persistence is required for AAI-03. Adapter descriptors and deterministic negotiation are repository/runtime-pure contracts; credentials and provider sessions are explicitly excluded. Migration 0022 remains unreserved.

validation_contract.focused: Prove adapter-kind/capability coverage, exact AAI-01 evidence-state inheritance, fail-closed negotiation mapping, deterministic authored/stable adapter selection, manual/external-reference outcomes, separation from AAI-02 identity, no rights override, no provider calls/credentials/content acquisition, owner nonmutation and no migration 0022 reservation.
validation_contract.predecessors: Run AAI-02 canonical schema verifier, AAI-01 provider/API/license verifier and MIB-11/D18 World-owner regression on both required platforms.
validation_contract.workflow: Register AAI-03 in canonical Repository Health path coverage and self-hosted Validation Core discovery without introducing network/provider dependencies.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass Repository Health, self-hosted Linux and Windows AAI-03 Validation Core, deterministic cross-platform comparison and declared AAI-02/AAI-01/World-owner regressions before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01 and AAI-02 remain completed_verified with no further implementation authority
AAI-03 authority is limited to provider-neutral static adapter descriptors, deterministic capability negotiation, governed documentation, focused regression/verifier and Validation Core wiring
AAI-01 evidence states remain verbatim and fail closed; no provider capability may be inferred or upgraded
AAI-02 provider/source/asset/reference/intent/cue identities and rights evidence remain binding inputs and cannot be rewritten by negotiation
commercial provider audio remains controlled/referenced rather than copied absent explicit later license and authority
Pocket Bard scraping/reverse engineering restrictions and Tabletop Audio SoundPad site-bound restrictions remain binding evidence
AAI-04 playback/layering/mixing and AAI-05 semantic resolution remain unauthorized
no provider authentication/live catalog/provider calls/acquisition/download/copying/scraping/payment, tester distribution, release/deployment or real-money activation
